title: Recent Progress for Single-Molecule Magnets Based on Rare Earth Elements
claim: Vacuum evaporation, spin coating, and Langmuir-Blodgett deposition are the established routes for studying thin films of metal phthalocyanines, alongside solvothermal synthesis of LnPc.
explanation: The preparation section states that these film methods are widely used for MPc films and gives solvothermal synthesis of LnPc (Ln = Tb, Y) as an example of bulk preparation tied to film studies.
scope: Thin-film and solvothermal processing of metal and lanthanide phthalocyanines.
caveats: No film-thickness, substrate, or magnetic-performance comparison among the three deposition methods is provided.
